_comment: Copy to $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/simulacrum/config.json (default ~/.config/simulacrum/config.json). Never commit the real file. anthropic_api_key_env lists the env vars to read the Anthropic key from, first set wins; default ["ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"]. SIMULACRUM_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY_ENV (comma-separated) overrides it.
